title: Count prefix writes to register 359
body:
## Summary
- Thirty-two events before index 24438 write register 359: 21 additions, 2 scales, 2 adapters and 7 climbs.
- The first is the adapter at event 7761. The last is the addition of `-1/128` times register 103 at event 24433.
- The fault instruction itself writes register 39. No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The amplitude at the cut is not evaluated.
